Robust Standard Errors

Source: R/mxHelper-robust-se.R
MxHelperRobustSE.Rd

Computes robust (sandwich) standard errors of a fitted model with OpenMx::imxRobustSE(), quietly. On an error, it returns NULL. The arguments are checked first; the internal version, without checks, is the one other projects copy.

Usage

MxHelperRobustSE(model)

Arguments

model

An OpenMx model (MxModel), usually fitted.

Value

Returns the list of OpenMx::imxRobustSE() with details = TRUE (SE, cov, bread, meat, TIC), or NULL.

See also

Other Model Fitting Functions: MxHelperEnsureGoodHessian(), MxHelperForceHessianOptions(), MxHelperMuSigma(), MxHelperQuiet(), MxHelperReadRunSave(), MxHelperReadRunSaveNoHessian(), MxHelperRun(), MxHelperRunNoHessian(), MxHelperStripHessian()

Author

Ivan Jacob Agaloos Pesigan

Examples

set.seed(seed = 42)
x <- data.frame(
  y1 = rnorm(n = 50),
  y2 = rnorm(n = 50)
)
fit <- MxHelperQuiet(
  expr = MxHelperMuSigma(
    x = x,
    extraTries = 2
  )
)
MxHelperRobustSE(
  model = fit
)$SE
#>  FIML.l[1,1]  FIML.l[2,1]  FIML.l[2,2] FIML.mu[1,1] FIML.mu[1,2] 
#>   0.10849083   0.13985675   0.09329834   0.16284481   0.13081303
